sourceBase.method: Original POSITION/index transformed into bottom-center pivot coordinates; downward triangles in lowest 1% of source height; largest horizontal underside plane grouped at 1e-6 source units; 21x21 lower-envelope grid. Area sums may include overlapping triangles; finite contact diagnostic, not topology certification.

structure.method: World POSITION/index. Sum original slab top triangles clipped to actual source-base XZ envelope; the real stair void is excluded by the original slab triangles. Envelope coverage is NOT physical support. Actual 425-point lower-surface rays measure contact separately. Convex guard/inner-stair volumes test every original candidate POSITION vertex with 1e-5m containment tolerance; positive hits prove penetration, zero hits do not prove all triangle intersections absent.
structure.integration: No slab, guard, stair, terrain, navigation or source-model edits; P3-B1 is not executed.

calibration.diagnostics: Actual source lower-surface samples vs visible existing supports. Convex obstacle vertex containment proves positive conflicts only; absence of a sampled conflict is not complete collision proof.
